definition.description: Converts JSON data to XML format. Supports nested objects, arrays, and primitive values.

inputFields.helpText: The JSON string to convert to XML. Can be an object, array, or primitive value.
The name of the XML root element. Default is 'root'.
The element name to use for array items. Default is 'item'.
Whether to format the output XML with indentation and newlines.
Whether to include the <?xml version="1.0"?> declaration at the top.

outputParameters.description: True if an error occurred during conversion

connectionTags.description: Triggered when JSON was successfully converted to XML
Triggered when conversion fails (invalid JSON or processing error)
